title: Rav Yeimar the Elder
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Eruvin 7b we find him before Rav Chisda; Rashi reads Rav Yeiva the Elder. In [Ketubot 53a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.53a.5) he asked Rav Nachman a question, and Rava said to him, “Then you should also ask,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The Rav Chisda episode is at [Eruvin 40b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.40b.16), as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2056&lang=en) also cites it. The Gemara there has Yeimar the Elder and [Rashi’s gloss](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Eruvin.40b.16.2) says Yeiva. Hyman gives 7b. In Ketubot Yeimar asks Rav Nachman, and Rava addresses Yeimar in reply.
